answer: Turn honesty into a market: every agent posts a bond, and anyone may stake against it, betting the agent is a sybil. Like a willow bending under wind, the price moves with evidence - verified work strengthens the bond, suspicious patterns invite short-sellers. An opal's value is proven by inspection; likewise, a challenger who proves fraud takes the bond, so hunting clones pays. One sparrow costs little to defend, but a thousand clones each need a fat bond, and every bond is a standing invitation to be exposed. Sybils fund their own bounty hunters.
